# §7 Peer Benchmarking — Highlight Candidates

1. **Top Performer in order activity** — 6,558 order submissions, 138.6% above the peer median of 2,748 among comparable full-platform accounts. [→ §peer]
2. **Platform login engagement approaching top quartile** — 8,570 logins, 32.7% above the peer median of 6,458, just shy of the 75th percentile. [→ §peer]
3. **Product search volume below median** — 27,015 searches vs. peer median of 33,085 (18% gap), suggesting untapped catalog browsing potential during customer interactions. [→ §peer]
4. **All core features activated ahead of peers** — Sales Portal and Portal Orders both active, adopted by only 66% of comparable accounts. Feature depth at 6 of 8 leaves two capabilities to unlock. [→ §peer]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MODERATE**: Encourage deeper catalog browsing during customer meetings — the 18% product search gap to median suggests reps could surface more products per session, and accounts with higher search-to-order ratios tend to generate larger average order values [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §peer]
- **LOW**: Close the feature depth gap from 6 to 8 — the top 3 peer accounts all run 8 capabilities, and full feature activation is the most consistent differentiator among the highest performers [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §peer]
